# mtncloud_provision_type (Data Source)

Provides a MTN Cloud provision type data source.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "mtncloud_provision_type" "provision_layout" {
  name = "VMware"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `name` (String) The name of the MTN Cloud provision type

### Read-Only

- `id` (Number) The ID of this resource.
